# Tabloo

Public, no-auth JSON files for current and historical Iranian market prices.

Use raw.githubusercontent.com URLs below for current data (about 5 minutes of cache). The optional
jsDelivr form is https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hidevs/tabloo@main/data/{FILE},
which can cache the main branch for about 12 hours.

- Website and documentation: https://hidevs.github.io/tabloo/
- All latest prices in toman: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/latest-toman.json
- Curated popular prices: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/popular.json
- Complete canonical symbol guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/symbols.json
- Complete published-history directory: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/history/index.json
- USD/IRR daily OHLC history: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/history/USD_IRR_FREE.json
- Gold 18K/IRR daily OHLC history: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/history/GOLD_18K_IRR.json
- Emami coin/IRR daily OHLC history: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/history/COIN_EMAMI_IRR.json
- USDT/IRR daily OHLC history: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/history/USDT_IRR.json
- Manifest and update metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hidevs/tabloo/main/data/manifest.json

Current-price files update every 30 minutes. Daily-history files update once per day. Current upstream source: TGJU. Prices are informational.
